title:
A piece of parsed documentation markup. This type is just a marker type; only its sub-types are instantiated.
This is a parsed version of the text specified in source code comments (metadata or extension language) or from a
stand-alone documentation file.

The markup is authored in [Markdown](https://commonmark.org/) with
[GitHub extensions](https://help.github.com/articles/github-flavored-markdown/).
See those pages for the full syntax, but some examples of inline markup:

| Effect          | Code                            | Result                        |
|-----------------|---------------------------------|-------------------------------|
| emphasis        | `_important_`                   | _important_                   |
| strong emphasis | `**more important**`            | **more important**            |
| code            | `\`4 == 2 + 2\``                | `4 == 2 + 2`                  |
| strikethrough   |  `~~deprecated~~`               | ~~deprecated~~                |
| link            | `[Example](http://example.com)` | [Example](http://example.com) |

We also have several additional extensions:
 - JavaDoc style links: `{@link Array}`
 - image sizing: `![logo](img/logo.png@24x24)`
 - LaTeX math: `$$a \equiv b$$`
 - tabbed content sections: `=== Tab`

Finally, HTML is not supported and will be rendered as plain text. However, HTML comments will be removed from
the output.

@see DocumentationSpan
@see DocumentationReference
@see DocumentationBlock
@see Markdown
name: DocumentationMarkup
